Lot area: 77,679 m² (City parcel data).
Zone floor-space ratio 3 (as if rezoned): 77,679 × 3 = 233,037 m².
Storeys under the 18.3 m height limit: first floor 6.0 m, then data-hall floors of 6.0 or 5.5 m. (18.3 − 6.0) ÷ 6.0 = 2.05, whole floors 2, plus the first floor = 3; with 5.5 m floors, 2.24 → 2 + 1 = 3.

Ground floor (no data storage at grade): floor area ÷ storeys = 231,567 ÷ 3 = 77,189 m². Floors above: 231,567 − 77,189 = 154,378 m².
Data hall, strict reading (only the floors above, and only part of them is hall): 154,378 × 0.48 = 74,101 m², up to 154,378 × 0.72 = 111,152 m².
Data hall, lenient reading (support rooms on the ground floor, so the hall share applies to the whole building, but the hall still fits only on the floors above): smaller of 231,567 × 0.48 and 154,378 = 111,152 m², up to smaller of 231,567 × 0.72 and 154,378 = 154,378 m².
Servers: the smallest hall laid out loosely, 74,101 ÷ 630 m² per MW = 40.0 MW; the largest hall laid out densely, 154,378 ÷ 290 = 40.0 MW (capped at 40 MW, the tool's range).
Check: 231,567 ÷ 1,109 = 209 MW; 231,567 ÷ 505 = 459 MW.
